technology_name: The Centre of Excellence in Nutraceuticals (CoEN) Services & Formulations
problem_solved: The lack of scientific validation, standardized efficacy testing, and optimized bioavailability for traditional herbal and ethnomedicinal remedies.
description: A premier research hub dedicated to the scientific validation and commercialization of natural bioactive compounds. The center is currently developing standardized, evidence-backed products like a 10-plant 'Dasapushpam' polyherbal mix for immune resilience, and a synergistic 'Manjal-Kurumulak' (Turmeric-Black Pepper) capsule designed to drastically enhance curcumin absorption.

• Contract research for toxicity, efficacy, and regulatory compliance testing
